interface.shortDescription: Scan tools for a safety score
interface.longDescription: AgentAvow tells you whether a tool is safe before your agent connects to it. Give it an MCP server, a package (npm, PyPI, crates, Docker, or Hugging Face), or a GitHub repo, and it returns a 0–100 trust score and a letter grade backed by a signed attestation anyone can recompute offline. It checks for known-malicious versions, supply-chain and dependency risk, and code-safety issues, then shows an interactive trust card. Eight read-only tools cover scanning a repo, package, or live MCP server; verifying a score; checking interaction safety before you connect; looking up an identity; and getting an embeddable badge. No account, no sign-in, and nothing is modified — every call is anonymous and read-only.

publication.release_notes: Adds a bundled skill, scan-before-connect, that picks the right scan tool for a repo, package, or MCP server and reports the verdict without overstating it. Adds capability labels and starter prompts. No tools were added or removed.
